body.x: LAS VEGAS USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2013')--NDS Solution (www.netds.net), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, unveiled Digital Siganage program, 'Q-Sign' at the world's largest Consumer Electronic show, CES 2013, from Jan 8 to 11.
'Q-SIGN' is able to totally manage variety of contents through network for broadcasting, advertising and guide.
Also 'Q-Design Manager' provides usuability through split screen effects and it maximizes effectiveness by applying variety of contents and applications to image, videos, flash, PPT and subtitles.
In addition, network certifies serial number through Q-USB round key in unstable environment so it provides high level of suitability in variety of networks.
This program is certified with high performance for its price and has branches in 10 countries with English, Japanese, Chines, French, Spanish, Arabian, Turkish available.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
